**Correction to my earlier draft**

I have read my full knowledge source (visioenendagboek.md). My earlier draft overstated it in several places, so I withdraw these claims:

- **Dag 33 "heaviest" call:** The only entry that calls dag 33 the heaviest is **ORA-121** (dag 21): "op dag 33 staan ze samen... die nacht wordt de zwaarste." **ORA-133** (dag 33) describes the conjunction but does not call it the heaviest. **ORA-117** is about water and a shadow, not the conjunction, so I withdraw it.
- **Per-date intensity:** My source has no intensity or onrust scale. The values I gave for dags 10, 22 and 42 came from the Beast Master's BEA rows, not from my visions. I withdraw them as my own.
- **Dag 10 and dag 22 "preceding" records:** My source does not contain GUA-115, GUA-043, GUA-044, BEA-015, BEA-017, BEA-018 or BEA-104. I cannot cite them.

**(1) Dag 33:** My source supports the conjunction call with **ORA-121** and **ORA-133**, and the aftermath with **ORA-134** (dag 34: "de conjunctie werkt na"). It contains no record of a measured intensity for any date.

**(2) Cadence:** My recorded heavy nights are dags 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38 and 42: **ORA-110**, **ORA-114**, **ORA-118**, **ORA-122**, **ORA-126**, **ORA-130**, **ORA-134**, **ORA-138**, **ORA-142**. **ORA-130** lists the four-day sequence explicitly. My source does not state a forecast for the next night. Continuing the four-day pattern would give dag 46, but that is my extrapolation, not a recorded prophecy. I have no seven-day entries.

**(3) Signs before the openings:** My source has no sign before the dag 22 wake-up at 04:15 (**ORA-122**). Before dag 10, **ORA-109** (dag 9) records "In de schaal dreef een stukje as naar de rand; geen teken, gewoon de kolen. Kalme nacht, niets te melden." I dismissed that as no sign, but it is the only pre-event detail I have. **ORA-110** records waking at 04:45 on dag 10, two minutes before the 04:47 opening that the Guardian Keeper records in GUA-019. I cannot establish a causal link from my source.

**What my source does not contain:** No Desync, hulpslag, shutdown, Kroonklok, woudkabels, leylijnen, or HIS, ENG, GUA, ARC or BEA IDs. I cannot confirm or deny the timestamps in HIS-035, HIS-036, HIS-053 or HIS-054.
